title: Cardioversion & defibrillation
regimen: Pulse → SYNC · no pulse → UNSYNC · midazolam sedation
dagger_note: † = clinical or local addition, not in the SA STG. Any item without a source page is †; items with a page are from the STG.
item_format: steps[].actions[]: n=number, t=action, x=detail, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold. steps[].sequence[]: ordered cells (m=a/b/c). steps[].decisions[]: if/then. reference{}: blocks (items or table).

items.t: Unstable tachycardia: hypotension, altered mental status, chest pain, acute HF, shock
Regular wide-QRS (VT) — first line even if stable
Irregular wide > 170 / WPW-AF — no drugs
Flutter: most effective therapy
SVT failing adenosine or hypotensive
Pulseless VT / VF (cardiac arrest)
Torsades / polymorphic VT, unstable
Sync shock will not fire (no R wave detected)
Sinus tachycardia (compensatory)
Stable AF / flutter > 48 h: defer until 4 weeks warfarin
Suspected digoxin toxicity: discuss first
K⁺ low → correct (wide QRS)
Torsades → MgSO₄ 2 g IV
Pacemaker: pads ≥ 8 cm from box
Wet chest / GTN patch / O₂ near pads

steps.title: Prepare
steps.subtitle: monitor, access, airway kit, check sync capability

actions.x: ECG, SpO₂, BP cuff; print rhythm strip + 12-lead if time
BVM, suction on, OPA, RSI drugs if GCS falls

actions.t: Tell the patient; consent if conscious

steps.title: Pads on, choose mode
steps.subtitle: pulse present = SYNC · no pulse = UNSYNC

actions.x: anterolateral: R infraclavicular + L mid-axillary V6; or antero-posterior
check a marker sits on every R wave, not on T waves

actions.t: Select energy from the table below

decisions.then: SYNC OFF → defibrillate now, start CPR (4.4)

steps.title: Sedate
steps.subtitle: if time permits; unstable + falling GCS: shock first

actions.x: no response to voice; loss of eyelash reflex
jaw thrust / BVM if SpO₂ falls

sequences.label: a midazolam ▶ (repeat after 2–3 min) ▶ b shock

actions.t: Charge; check nobody touches patient or bed
Press and HOLD the shock button
actions.x: SYNC delays the shock until the next R wave

actions.t: Pulseless: UNSYNC shock, resume CPR 2 min

steps.title: Reassess & escalate
steps.subtitle: rhythm and pulse after every shock

actions.t: Check rhythm and pulse; print strip
Not converted: re-press SYNC, next energy
No response to DC cardioversion: consult specialist

decisions.then: SYNC OFF, defibrillate unsynchronised, CPR; amiodarone 300 mg IV after adrenaline, then 150 mg

actions.t: Observe RR, SpO₂, GCS every 5 min until awake
Document time, rhythm before / after, J, SYNC/UNSYNC, drugs; refer all wide QRS

items.t: Midazolam 1–2.5 mg IV over 2–3 min, repeat after 2–3 min
Amiodarone: arrest 300 mg → 150 mg; VT recurring 5 mg/kg over 30 min
Never adenosine / verapamil in wide QRS
Sync resets to OFF after each shock on many defibs — re-press
Use the defibrillator's own biphasic energy escalation if it differs
No sync marker / chaotic rhythm → unsynchronised
